samples.xml_description:
<module id="clkgenerator">
    <description>Generates a periodic clock signal with a specified period.</description>
    <ports>
        <output id="clk">The output clock signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="PERIOD">The period of the clock signal.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>Initializes the clock signal to 0 and toggles it every half of the specified period.</implementation>
</module>
